svg.aria-label: Attacks that leave satellites in orbit
svg.title: Attacks that leave satellites in orbit
svg.desc: Jamming, spoofing, laser and cyber operations, as campaigns and single events. Bar: a campaign that lasted. Point: a single event. Arrowhead: still going. Solid fill: attributed by a government or several governments. Outline only: attributed by researchers or open-source analysis. Dashed outline: alleged. Attribution is recorded as the source states it.

text.style: fill:rgb(14, 20, 34);font:500 29px "Libre Bodoni","Libre Bodoni Fallback","Bodoni 72",Didot,"Iowan Old Style",Georgia,serif

svg.text: Attacks that leave satellites in orbit

text.style: fill:#3c4660;font:400 14.5px "Public Sans","Public Sans Fallback",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: Jamming, spoofing, laser and cyber operations, as campaigns and single events.

desc.style: fill:rgb(0, 0, 0);fill-opacity:1;stroke:none;stroke-width:1px;stroke-dasharray:none;stroke-opacity:1;stroke-linecap:butt;stroke-linejoin:miter;opacity:1;font-family:"Public Sans", "Public Sans Fallback", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:400;font-variant-numeric:normal;letter-spacing:normal;text-anchor:start;text-transform:none;display:inline;paint-order:normal

svg.desc: Chart of jamming, laser and cyber operations against satellites, in four groups, one line per entry. Bars are campaigns over a period, dots are single events and an arrow means the campaign is still going. A solid fill means governments or an international body attribute the activity, an outline means researchers or open-source analysts, and a dashed outline means it is alleged. A data table follows the chart.
